package hybridapplication

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type testClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (c testClock) Now() time.Time { return c.now }

type recordingApplications struct {
	creates, gets, applies int
	actor, path, id        string
	intent                 domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection
	err                    error
}

func (r *recordingApplications) CreateHybridLearningIntent(_ context.Context, actor string, p domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	r.creates++
	r.actor = actor
	r.intent = p
	return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{Intent: p}, r.err
}
func (r *recordingApplications) GetHybridLearningIntent(_ context.Context, actor, path, id string) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	r.gets++
	r.actor = actor
	r.path = path
	r.id = id
	return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, r.err
}
func (r *recordingApplications) ApplyHybridConsequence(context.Context, domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error) {
	r.applies++
	return domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{}, r.err
}
func TestServiceLearnerActorAndServerTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &recordingApplications{}
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 10, 0, 0, 123456789, time.FixedZone("client", 5*3600))
	s := Service{Applications: repo, Clock: testClock{now}}
	actor, path, id := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	input := CreateIntentInput{IntentID: id, ExpectedPathRevision: 3, Kind: "CHANGE_GOAL", RequestedChange: domain.HybridRequestedChange{Scope: domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: "backend", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []domain.HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	receipt, err := s.CreateIntent(context.Background(), actor, path, input)
	if err != nil || repo.creates != 1 || repo.actor != actor || receipt.Intent.StudentID != actor || receipt.Intent.LearningPathID != path || receipt.Intent.CreatedAt.Location() != time.UTC || !receipt.Intent.CreatedAt.Equal(now.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)) {
		t.Fatalf("identity/time:%+v %v", receipt, err)
	}
	input.ExpectedPathRevision = 0
	if _, err = s.CreateIntent(context.Background(), actor, path, input); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || repo.creates != 1 {
		t.Fatal("invalid intent reached durable store")
	}
	if _, err = s.GetIntent(context.Background(), actor, path, id); err != nil || repo.gets != 1 || repo.actor != actor || repo.path != path || repo.id != id {
		t.Fatal("intent read not owner bound")
	}
	if _, err = s.GetIntent(context.Background(), "teacher", path, id); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || repo.gets != 1 {
		t.Fatal("invalid actor read reached store")
	}
}
func TestServiceConsequenceRequiresExactRouteIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &recordingApplications{}
	s := Service{Applications: repo}
	c := domain.HybridConsequence{StudentID: "one", LearningPathID: "path"}
	if _, err := s.Apply(context.Background(), "another", "path", c); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || repo.applies != 0 {
		t.Fatal("cross-owner consequence dispatched")
	}
}
